t.Auf dem Areal der ehemaligen Landis+Gyr: On the former Landis+Gyr site by the station, an urban district with a high share of housing is planned – with high-rises, added storeys and connected open spaces such as the «Gleisgärten». The Freiruum stays.
t.Die grösste zusammenhängende Baulandrese: The city's largest contiguous building land reserve: the commercial area is to become a green neighbourhood with homes, workplaces, a primary school and a park. Existing businesses can stay.
t.Das Metalli von 1987 wird weiterentwicke: The 1987 Metalli is being redeveloped: added storeys, replacement buildings and an 80-metre high-rise create mainly homes and office space. Shops and restaurants remain at today's scale.
t.Gegenüber der Bossard-Arena entsteht ein: Opposite the Bossard Arena, an indoor pool with a 50-metre basin is planned, together with renewed football and athletics facilities. Wishes from the public participation have been built into the competition brief.
t.Das Quartier wächst, die Schule ist zu k: The neighbourhood is growing and the school is too small. A four-storey new building along Industriestrasse adds classrooms, a sports hall and a public roof terrace. The neighbourhood was widely surveyed.
t.Die Oberstufenanlage von 1969 erhält ein: The 1969 secondary school is getting a timber school wing and a day-care building. After an appeal that went all the way to the Federal Supreme Court, construction started in 2025 – the topping-out has been celebrated.
t.Im wachsenden Herti-Quartier entsteht di: In the growing Herti neighbourhood, the first stage of the new school is being built. The old school building has already been converted for day care; the second stage will be planned afterwards.
t.Wo früher fixe Campingplätze standen, en: Where permanent camping pitches used to be, there is more space for everyone: green areas, paths, play areas, barbecue spots, a new restaurant and an underpass for bikes and pedestrians. City, Korporation and canton are building it together.
t.Die Spielregeln fürs Bauen werden erstma: The rules for building are being rewritten for the first time since 2010: densification, more affordable housing, urban climate, open spaces and better protection of townscapes.
t.Die Korporation Zug plant zwischen Nords: The Korporation Zug plans a large development of affordable rental flats between Nordstrasse and the railway, mainly 3.5-room flats. Savings come from the basement and parking; it is built in brick and timber.
t.Auf dem Areal beim GIBZ soll das Wohnhoc: The residential high-rise «Pi», built in timber, is planned on the GIBZ site. Most of the flats are affordable; part of them will be taken over by the Gewoba cooperative. Voters said yes, but an appeal is still blocking construction.
t.Die Genossenschaft für gemeinnützigen Wo: The non-profit housing cooperative Gewoba is building an apartment block with 26 flats for around 70 people in Göbli. Flats are let at cost rent to members of the cooperative.

No private listings: this is about flats let at cost rent.
t.preisgünstige oder genossenschaftliche W: affordable or cooperative flats are firmly planned or under construction – out of a total of 619 flats in these projects. In addition, there are 3 projects whose numbers are still open.
t.Zum Vergleich: Die Initiative «2000 Wohn: For comparison: the initiative «2000 flats for Zug's middle class» calls for around 2,000 new affordable flats by 2040 (20 % of the housing stock). Voters narrowly accepted it on 18 June 2023.
t.Die Initiative «2000 Wohnungen für den Z: The initiative «2000 flats for Zug's middle class» calls for around 2,000 new affordable flats by 2040 (20 % of the housing stock). Voters narrowly accepted it on 18 June 2023.

t.Die Stadt vermietet eigene preisgünstige: The city lets its own affordable flats. They are allocated via an application form (online or PDF, in German).
t.Mindestbelegung: 3,5 Zimmer ab 2 Persone: Minimum occupancy: 3.5 rooms from 2 people, 4.5 rooms from 3 people (incl. 1 child or person in initial training), 5.5 rooms from 4 people (incl. 2)
t.Steuerbares Einkommen höchstens das Vier: Taxable income at most four times the annual net rent

t.Für ältere Menschen vermietet die Stadt: For older people, the city lets retirement flats (including Bergli, Frauensteinmatt, Neustadt 2). Applications go through a separate waiting list.
t.Stadt Zug, Fachstelle Alter und Gesundhe: City of Zug, Office for Ageing and Health
t.Genossenschaften vermieten zur Kostenmie: Cooperatives let flats at cost rent, i.e. without profit. As a rule, only members can apply. So it pays to become a member early – even before a specific letting.
t.Gewoba – Genossenschaft für gemeinnützig: Gewoba – non-profit housing cooperative: become a member, register interest
t.awzug – Allgemeine Wohnbaugenossenschaft: awzug – general housing cooperative Zug: membership application, allocation according to its rules
t.Rund 1900 Wohnungen im Kanton sind dem W: Around 1,900 flats in the canton fall under the housing promotion act and are let at cost rent. Low-income households can also receive rent subsidies there. The landlord knows whether a flat qualifies.
t.Bewerben können sich nur Mitglieder der: Only Gewoba members can apply. If you are looking for a flat, first become a member and register your interest.
